//: Editor excludes for a workspace whose root holds ~400 GB of simulation output. Measured 2026-08-23:
pyrightconfig.json already scopes TYPE ANALYSIS to first-party code. This file covers the two things it
does not: the FILE WATCHER and SEARCH.
files.watcherExclude is the important one, and it is not covered by .gitignore. VS Code's watcher does
not read .gitignore — only search does, via search.useIgnoreFiles. So even though runs/ and friends are
gitignored, the watcher was still registering recursive handles over a 310 GB tree. On Windows that
costs handles and CPU; on Linux it exhausts inotify watches outright.
refit_sweep/ (2.7G), parca4_work/, vendor/ and archive/ are NOT gitignored — they are working artefacts
that were never meant to be indexed either, and vendor/ + archive/ additionally carry duplicate copies of
the wcEcoli package layout, which is the auto-import hazard pyrightconfig.json exists to stop.
